net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 針對傳統商品橫斷面動能績效惡化問題，將短期記憶指標「變異數比（Variance Ratio, VR）」與長期記憶指標「Hurst 指數」嵌入動能選股流程，識別趨勢延續性高的標的；實證證明基於變異數比的記憶增強動能策略顯著超越傳統動能、有效防範動能崩盤且對交易成本穩健。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 工程化落地「變異數比條件動能（VR-Conditioned Momentum）」：以多日累積報酬變異數與單日變異數之比值過濾均值回歸雜訊股，僅對 `VR > 1` 具正自相關記憶之標的施加趨勢動能：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 126)) * rank(ts_var(ts_sum(returns, 5), 60) / (5 * ts_var(returns, 60) + 1e-6)), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: News Sentiment and Commodity Futures Investing
net_new_papers.track: Track 8: Commodity Futures Term Structure: Convenience Yield, Roll Yield, Hedging Pressure & Cross-Commodity Momentum
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 系統評估媒體新聞情緒於商品期貨投資之定價能力：依新聞情緒排序並採週頻再平衡的多空組合扣除交易成本後仍獲約 8.3% 年化報酬，且在控制各項傳統商品因子後時間序列異常報酬與橫斷面風險溢酬皆顯著高於 7%–8%，顯著提升商品組合績效。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 若接入新聞情緒欄位 `news_sentiment`，於週頻視窗計算標準化新聞情緒動能並對商品／能源原物料次產業中性化：`group_neutralize(ts_zscore(ts_mean(news_sentiment, 5), 63), subindustry)`；在標準量價場域則以「財報／分析師預期修正 × 媒體關注度」代理情緒溢酬。

net_new_papers.title: Commodity Tail Risk and Equity Risk Premia
net_new_papers.track: Track 8: Commodity Futures Term Structure: Convenience Yield, Roll Yield, Hedging Pressure & Cross-Commodity Momentum
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 彙總個別商品期貨對系統性風險左尾極端事件之暴露度建構「商品尾部風險（Commodity Tail Risk）」指標，於 2005–2022 年中國市場實證發現高低暴露股票極端投資組合之風險調整後月報酬差達 1.39%；經濟機制在於商品尾部風險預警總體經濟惡化，能對沖商品尾部風險的股票因而僅要求較低溢酬。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在股票橫斷面建構「商品左尾避險 Beta」因子：計算個股報酬對大宗商品／能源指數極端下跌日（最差 10% 交易日）的敏感度並取負向排序，捕捉不願承擔商品尾部風險之投資人所支付的防禦溢酬：`group_neutralize(-rank(ts_corr(returns, min(commodity_ret, 0), 126)), sector)`。

net_new_papers.title: Flight to Safety or Flight from Carry?
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 區分危機期間外匯市場之「避險資金流入（Flight to Safety）」與「利差交易平倉（Flight from Carry）」，實證機構資金於避險期集中買入低風險貨幣並同步拋售高息擁擠利差部位，導致高息貨幣出現非對稱崩盤。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「利差平倉擁擠度」避險濾網：在市場波動率急升期，做多低槓桿、高現金比之防禦型資產並做空高波動擁擠成長股：`if_else(ts_rank(group_std_dev(returns, market), 252) > 0.8, group_neutralize(rank(cash / debt) - rank(ts_std_dev(returns, 21)), sector), group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 63)), sector))`。

net_new_papers.title: Volatility Shocks and Currency Returns
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 利用時變參數向量自迴歸（TVP-VAR）建構外匯隱含波動率衝擊傳導網路，發現強波動率輸出國（Volatility Transmitters）未來貨幣超額報酬顯著較低，且該策略在低流動性與高波動期具備卓越分散化效益。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 計算個股波動率變動對同業板塊波動率之領先—滯後外溢強度（To-Connectedness Proxy），做空高特質跳躍輸出者、做多低傳染性穩健標的：`group_neutralize(-rank(ts_corr(ts_delta(historical_volatility_20, 1), ts_delay(group_mean(ts_delta(historical_volatility_20, 1), 1, sector), -1), 63)), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Collateral Advantage: Exchange Rates, Capital Flows, and Global Cycles
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 解釋為何美國作為淨債務國其貨幣（美元）卻在危機期間逆勢升值：因美國國債具備全球金融仲介「抵押品優勢（Collateral Advantage）」，危機推升安全資產便利殖利率並觸發全球美元升值與資本迴流。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在全球跨國資產配置中，於全球緊縮與波動率上升期超配具備「高品質抵押品屬性」（高信用評等、高現金覆蓋、低短期債務比）之大型龍頭企業：`group_neutralize(rank(cash / short_term_debt) * rank(log(market_cap)), country)`。

net_new_papers.title: Dollar Erosion: Understanding the Loss of Reserve Currency Status
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 剖析 2025 年 4 月衝擊後美元與美債便利殖利率下滑伴隨美元實質貶值之異常相關性變化，校準模型估計失去安全資產需求將導致美元實質匯率穩態貶值約 7.6%、美債便利殖利率下降 0.9% 與美債長端利率上升 0.9%。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 針對美元計價之跨國出口商與原物料類股建立「弱美元—美債長端利率上行」對沖籃子：於實質利率上行且美元走弱狀態超配海外營收佔比高且低負債之跨國企業：`group_neutralize(rank(sales / assets) - rank(debt_lt / equity), sector)`。

net_new_papers.title: The Missing Risk Premium in Exchange Rates
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 建構實質匯率現值模型（Present-Value Model），證實實質匯率相較長期均衡的偏離（REER / PPP 價值因子）包含一個獨立於利差之外的「缺失風險溢酬」，且該潛在風險溢酬主導實質匯率大部分變異並顯著預測未來貨幣報酬。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 將實質匯率現值均值回歸架構遷移至跨市場價值因子：以長期移動平均價格比值（504 日均值相對現價）與短期利差／殖利率動能分離純淨價值回歸訊號：`group_neutralize(rank(log(ts_mean(close, 504) / close)) + 0.5 * rank(ebitda / enterprise_value), country)`。

net_new_papers.title: Exchange Rate Risk and Deviations From Purchasing Power Parity
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 提出解決購買力平價（PPP）之謎的高階動差風險模型，實證對美主要淨出口國（加、日、歐）匯率偏離 PPP 的長期風險溢酬主要由「預期名目匯率偏態（Skewness）」與適度波動不確定性驅動。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在跨國出口導向製造業選股中，將「隱含／已實現報酬偏態」納入估值折價修正項，做多低左尾偏態且估值低於長期均值之標的：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_skewness(returns, 126)) * rank(book_value / market_cap), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: AI and Exchange Rate Predictability
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 利用 GPT-3.5 與 GPT-4o 的訓練知識截止日斷點（2021 年 9 月 vs. 2023 年 10 月）進行嚴格前視偏誤（Look-Ahead Bias）對照檢定，驗證大型語言模型結合總經文本提示在樣本外匯率預測中具備真實資訊增益且非記憶預訓練數據所致。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在量化研究管線中為 LLM 總經／匯率文本情緒因子建立「時間截止點嚴格盲測協議」，於 BRAIN 中將新聞情緒突變與總經敏感股交叉：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_zscore(snt_news_sentiment, 21)) * rank(ts_beta(returns, group_mean(returns, 1, market), 63)), sector)`。

net_new_papers.title: Bank Positions in FX Swaps: Insights from CLS
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 串聯 CLS 外匯結算數據與 BIS 銀行統計，揭示美資銀行相較歐日銀行在外匯掉期市場扮演核心期限轉換（Maturity Transformation）中介角色，並量化非銀機構表外合成美元債務之龐大錯配規模與季底展期風險。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 針對全球跨國銀行與金融中介類股，量化表外融資與期限轉換溢酬：做多具備高資產規模與低負債到期波動度之美元結算核心大行：`group_neutralize(rank(log(assets)) * rank(net_income / assets) - rank(short_term_debt / liabilities), subindustry)`。

net_new_papers.title: One Dollar, Many Prices: Dealer-Specific Pricing of Synthetic Dollar Funding
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 運用英國監管逐筆交易數據分解合成美元融資（FX Forward/Swap）執行價格為共同遠期曲線、交易商與買賣單邊特定楔子（Dealer Wedge）及交易殘差，證實即使在同質美元資金市場，交易商資產負債表與客戶分層亦導致顯著差異化定價。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 借鏡「共同曲線＋個體交易楔子」分解架構，於 BRAIN 中對個股價差／非流動性成本扣除產業共同流動性成分，萃取純淨個體交易摩擦溢酬：`group_neutralize(rank(abs(returns) / (volume * vwap + 1e-6) - group_mean(abs(returns) / (volume * vwap + 1e-6), 1, industry)), subindustry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Settlement Risk and Currency Markets
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 以 2015 年匈牙利福林（HUF）納入 CLS 同步交割（PvP）系統為準自然實驗，採雙重差分法（DiD）因果證明外匯交割風險屬於顯著定價摩擦：接入 CLS 後貨幣超額報酬下降約 10 bps、匯率波動率降低且三角套利偏離收斂。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 將「交割與套利摩擦溢價」映射至跨國新興市場與多市場雙重掛牌標的：在無摩擦大盤市場做多低摩擦高效率標的，在新興／高摩擦宇宙萃取風險補償溢酬：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_std_dev(returns, 63)) * rank(-adv20 / market_cap), country)`（僅限風險受控組合）。

net_new_papers.title: Optimal Exchange Rate Policy
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 建構含 UIP 衝擊與金融中介約束的最適匯率政策理論：證明最優政策組合應以傳統利率政策對準通膨與產出缺口，而以「外匯干預（FXI）」精準抵銷非基本面金融流動性衝擊（消除 UIP 風險分擔楔子），同時放任匯率反映實體基本面。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 實作「基本面趨勢 vs. 金融流動性衝擊」雙軌分離因子：當股票／貨幣波動源自短期無基本面支持之資金衝擊（高換手無盈餘修正）時執行反向均值回歸，若伴隨基本面修正則順勢持有：`if_else(abs(ts_delta(est_eps_mean, 21)) < 1e-4, group_neutralize(-rank(ts_sum(returns, 5)), industry), group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 21)), industry))`。

net_new_papers.title: The Impact of Currency Carry Trade Activity on the Transmission of Monetary Policy
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 透過門檻向量自迴歸（TVAR）區分投機性利差交易活躍度狀態，證實美元對傳統緊縮貨幣政策衝擊升值、對央行資訊衝擊（Information Shock）貶值；結合央行公告日股債利率同步移動（Joint Co-movement）之交易策略在夏普率與下檔風險上大幅擊敗傳統利差交易。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 直接轉譯「股債／利率公告日共動狀態切換」至股票因子：依據市場指數與利率／防禦板塊在宏觀窗口的同向或反向相關性，辨識「傳統緊縮衝擊」與「經濟樂觀資訊衝擊」以切換風格權重：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_corr(returns, group_mean(returns, 1, sector), 21) * sign(ts_sum(group_mean(returns, 1, market), 5))), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Escaping the Financial Dollarization Trap: The Role of Foreign Exchange Intervention
net_new_papers.track: Track 9: Foreign Exchange Quantitative Strategies: FX Carry, PPP/Value, Dollar Risk Factor, Order Flow & Central Bank Intervention
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 以 45 國面板 VAR 與小型開放經濟 DSGE 模型實證：在具外幣負債美元化（Liability Dollarization）的經濟體中，全球資本外流衝擊會透過資產負債表惡化被劇烈放大，而積極的沖銷式外匯干預（Sterilized FXI）能有效平抑實質匯率貶值與產出波動。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 針對新興市場與高外債槓桿企業建構「貨幣錯配脆弱度（Currency Mismatch Vulnerability）」做空／避險因子：在強美元與資本外流期做空高外幣負債／低本土現金流緩衝標的：`group_neutralize(-rank(debt_lt / assets) * rank(-cashflow_op / liabilities), country)`。

net_new_papers.title: Statistical Arbitrage in Polish Equities Market Using Deep Learning Techniques
net_new_papers.track: Track 10: Statistical Arbitrage, Cointegration / Pairs Trading, OU Optimal Stopping & PCA Residual Mean Reversion
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 將 Avellaneda & Lee (2008) PCA + OU 統計套利架構移植至波蘭股市並比較 ETF、PCA 與 LSTM 複製法；2017–2019 年 PCA 策略達成約 20% 累積報酬與最高 2.63 年化夏普，但 2020 年危機期間僅 ETF 複製法維持約 5% 正報酬。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 驗證結構性危機下行業 ETF 基準較純統計 PCA 具更強穩健性；於 BRAIN 中可結合產業均值基準與市場狀態過濾器，例如 `trade_when(ts_std_dev(mkt_ret, 20) < ts_mean(ts_std_dev(mkt_ret, 20), 252) * 1.5, -group_zscore(ts_sum(returns, 5), subindustry), -1)`。

net_new_papers.title: Optimal Trading of Microstructure Mean Reversion
net_new_papers.track: Track 10: Statistical Arbitrage, Cointegration / Pairs Trading, OU Optimal Stopping & PCA Residual Mean Reversion
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 將高頻買賣價差內之中間價跳躍均值回歸近似為 OU 過程，推導出含半價差成本 $\phi$ 之對稱最佳進出場頻寬公式 $\theta^*(\theta^*-\phi)=s_G^2$，證明僅覆蓋價差即交易的期望利潤為零，所有利潤皆來自等待的選擇權價值。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 實證「等待選擇權價值」對交易成本敏感型 Alpha 的重要性：設定嚴格進場閾值死區（Dead-zone），在 BRAIN 中透過 `trade_when(abs(ts_zscore(resid, 20)) > 1.5, -ts_zscore(resid, 20), 0)` 濾除微幅雜訊波動，減少無效換手。

net_new_papers.title: Optimal Strategies for Round-Trip Pairs Trading Under Geometric Brownian Motions
net_new_papers.track: Track 10: Statistical Arbitrage, Cointegration / Pairs Trading, OU Optimal Stopping & PCA Residual Mean Reversion
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 放寬傳統價差必須服從均值回歸的假設，假設雙股價格服從一般幾何布朗運動（GBM）並含固定手續費，透過求解 HJB 方程得出在多頭、空倉與空頭初始狀態下的最佳往返配對交易閾值曲線。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 啟發非平穩配對的相對強弱門檻設計：當兩檔標的缺乏嚴格長期共整合時，改用對數價格比 `log(close / ts_mean(close, 60))` 之橫截面排名差與動態止盈止損邊界，降低假共整合（Spurious Cointegration）風險。

net_new_papers.title: RAmmStein: Regime Adaptation in Mean-reverting Markets with Stein Thresholds -- Optimal Impulse Control in Concentrated AMMs
net_new_papers.track: Track 10: Statistical Arbitrage, Cointegration / Pairs Trading, OU Optimal Stopping & PCA Residual Mean Reversion
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 將均值回歸市場之再平衡建模為脈衝控制（Impulse Control）與 HJB-QVI 問題，並以含 OU 回歸速率 $\theta$ 特徵的 DDQN 學習「行動與不行動（Laziness）」邊界；於 1Hz 高頻數據實測減少 85% 再平衡次數並顯著提升扣除手續費後的淨 ROI。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 將「狀態感知惰性（Regime-Aware Laziness）」導入 Alpha 持倉管理：使用 `trade_when` 條件僅於訊號偏離超過顯著門檻或回歸速率升高時才調整部位，大幅削減不必要調倉摩擦。

net_new_papers.title: Application of Black-Litterman Bayesian in Statistical Arbitrage
net_new_papers.track: Track 10: Statistical Arbitrage, Cointegration / Pairs Trading, OU Optimal Stopping & PCA Residual Mean Reversion
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 將 Engle-Granger 共整合配對交易產生的相對報酬觀點（Views）嵌入 Black-Litterman 貝氏投資組合最佳化框架，解決傳統配對交易在極端市場或高波動期間無法如期收斂導致的嚴重回撤問題。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 以貝氏收縮概念結合市場均衡與均值回歸訊號：將短線統計套利 Alpha 與低波防禦因子或動量因子進行動態混合，並以波動率倒數 `1 / ts_std_dev(returns, 60)` 調節觀點信心水準，降低危機期尾部風險。

net_new_papers.title: An Application of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Process to Pairs Trading
net_new_papers.track: Track 10: Statistical Arbitrage, Cointegration / Pairs Trading, OU Optimal Stopping & PCA Residual Mean Reversion
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 比較基於 OU 過程參數估計之配對交易與傳統滾動視窗均值／標準差（Naive）策略，實證指出 OU 模型雖能有效捕捉訊號趨勢，但若未妥善處理非平穩配對與參數校準限制，其風險報酬比可能反而不及簡單滾動策略。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 提醒切勿盲目套用複雜參數模型：在 BRAIN 中可先以簡潔穩健的 `ts_zscore(log(close) - ts_regression(log(close), log(sector_idx), 60), 20)` 作為基準，僅在有明確樣本外 Sharpe 增益時才增加複雜度。

net_new_papers.title: The return of return dominance: Decomposing the cross-section of prices
net_new_papers.track: Track 11: Quantitative Equity Value & Quality Factors: Intangible Capital, R&D Capitalization, Operating Leverage & Profitability-Investment Interactions
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 分解橫截面本益比（P/E）離散度：發現高達 75% 的估值倍數差異反映在未來股票報酬差異，僅 25% 反映在未來盈餘成長差異（且在投資組合與個股層級皆成立），支持「折現率差異或錯誤定價主導長期價值報酬」的觀點。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 利用 P/E 對未來長期盈餘成長預期之殘差作為純折現率／錯誤定價價值訊號：`group_neutralize(regression_neut(rank(earnings / market_cap), rank(ltg_eps_forecast)), subindustry)`，避免買入僅因成長停滯而便宜的價值陷阱。

net_new_papers.title: Putting the Price in Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.track: Track 11: Quantitative Equity Value & Quality Factors: Intangible Capital, R&D Capitalization, Operating Leverage & Profitability-Investment Interactions
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 提出估計投資組合「異常價格（abnormal price，即市場價格相對於資產定價模型折現之股利現值的百分比落差）」的嚴謹時間序列方法，證明相對於 CAPM 僅需單一特徵——「調整後價值（adjusted value）」即可精簡解釋橫截面價格扭曲。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構扣除市場 Beta 與規模影響後的長期累積基本面—價格偏離指標（或 Beta 調整後帳面市值比），於中長持有期（`decay=63`）穩定收割價格向基本面現值收斂的異常報酬。

net_new_papers.title: Is the Value Premium Dead? Forecasting Value–Growth Cycles with the Implied Value Premium
net_new_papers.track: Track 11: Quantitative Equity Value & Quality Factors: Intangible Capital, R&D Capitalization, Operating Leverage & Profitability-Investment Interactions
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 建構隱含價值溢酬（implied value premium）指標來即時預測價值股與成長股的強弱週期，證明價值溢酬並未死亡，而是呈現強烈的均值回歸與週期性輪動，可透過事前估值利差進行有效因子擇時。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 實作即時價值利差（Value Spread）擇時閘門：計算全市場價值組與成長組的 `log(pb_growth / pb_value)` 歷史分位數 `ts_rank(val_spread, 1260)`，當利差處於歷史高分位時動態倍增價值因子權重。

net_new_papers.title: Intrinsic Value: A Solution to the Declining Performance of Book-to-Market
net_new_papers.track: Track 11: Quantitative Equity Value & Quality Factors: Intangible Capital, R&D Capitalization, Operating Leverage & Profitability-Investment Interactions
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 針對帳面市值比近年失效問題，驗證基於現金營業獲利與市價比（COP/P）及內在價值估計的改良價值指標：做多高 COP/P、做空低 COP/P 在 1990 年後仍賺取月均 0.78%（市值加權）至 1.04%（等權）報酬，且涵蓋大型股並取代傳統投資因子。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 直接以現金營業獲利對市價比取代傳統 PB：`group_neutralize(rank((ebitda - ts_delta(working_capital, 252) + rd_expense) / market_cap), industry)`，兼顧價值低估與真實現金流品質。

net_new_papers.title: The Momentum Gap and Return Predictability
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 探討形成期內價格路徑跳空與連續性對動能報酬預測力的影響，指出動能缺口（momentum gap）與資訊離散度深刻調節投資人反應不足與過度反應之強度。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 計算形成期報酬中的「最大單日報酬佔比」或正負日報酬比例（資訊離散度），剔除單日跳空驅動的偽動能、強化連續緩漲動能：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 231) - ts_sum(returns, 21)) * rank(ts_mean(returns > 0, 231) - ts_mean(returns < 0, 231)), subindustry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Decomposing momentum: The forgotten component
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 將 t−12 至 t−2 的標準動能拆解為「最高價前」與「最高價後」兩段：高達 84% 的動能利潤來自最高價之前的上漲階段（投資人反應不足）；該被遺忘的成分呈正偏度、無市場狀態依賴且能完美避開動能崩盤。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 捨棄傳統總累積報酬，計算股價距 52 週高點前的爬坡動能或以「相對高點距離」加權形成期早段報酬：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(ts_delay(returns, 63), 168) * (close / ts_max(high, 252))), industry)`，獲得正偏度且抗崩盤的動能 Alpha。

net_new_papers.title: All Days Are Not Created Equal: Understanding Momentum by Learning to Weight Past Returns
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 透過機器學習彈性加權過去每日已實現報酬，發現相較傳統等權動能更能主導並解釋橫斷面報酬，且於危機期間表現穩健；其中對財報公告日、全市場跳躍日與極端單日報酬的加權最具資訊含量。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 區分一般交易日與異常量能／資訊衝擊日，對放量資訊日給予較高權重、對無量雜訊日給予衰減，構造資訊加權動能：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns * log(1 + volume / adv20), 231) - ts_sum(returns * log(1 + volume / adv20), 21)), subindustry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Trend factors around the world: Performance and determinants
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 檢驗多均線趨勢因子（Trend Factor）於全球已開發與新興市場的表現，證實趨勢因子全面優於大盤、短期反轉、傳統動能與長期反轉，且在個人主義較高與證券法規執行較佳的市場獲利更豐。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 構建多尺度移動平均線正規化價格偏離（結合短、中、長均線之橫斷面線性組合／等權複合趨勢因子）：`group_neutralize(rank(close / ts_mean(close, 20) + close / ts_mean(close, 60) + close / ts_mean(close, 120) + close / ts_mean(close, 250)), industry)`，捕捉跨週期趨勢共振。

net_new_papers.title: Momentum-Managed Equity Factors
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 證實利用股票因子組合月度超額報酬的一階正自我相關性進行「因子動能擇時管理」（Momentum-Managed），能在所有主流因子大幅提升夏普比率並通過交易成本檢驗，表現優於波動率或估值擇時，且於衰退與危機期間尤強。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在單一 Alpha 中模擬「產業／風格因子動能」順勢強化：將個股特質動能與其所屬次產業近期平均動能結合，做多強勢產業中的領漲股：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 21)) * 0.4 + rank(group_mean(ts_sum(returns, 21), 1, subindustry)), market)`。

net_new_papers.title: Isolating momentum crashes
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 指出動能崩盤集中發生於空頭反彈期間，此時動能組合呈現負貝塔與高動能波動率；據此建構事前的系統性與動能專屬風險「崩盤隔離指標」，在 1928–2020 與國際樣本中使動能夏普比率翻倍。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在動能因子中直接對齊市場貝塔中性化，消除空頭反彈期的負貝塔曝險（即構造 Beta-Neutral 殘差動能）：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 231) - ts_sum(returns, 21) - ts_corr(returns, group_mean(returns, 1, market), 126) * (ts_std_dev(returns, 126) / (ts_std_dev(group_mean(returns, 1, market), 126) + 1e-6)) * (ts_sum(group_mean(returns, 1, market), 231) - ts_sum(group_mean(returns, 1, market), 21))), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Static signal definitions and momentum crash risk: Evidence from state-conditional momentum
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 以 S&P 500 成分股（2006–2025）前向滾動測試證實：動能崩盤風險部分源自「跨越不同市場狀態卻強加固定訊號定義」；狀態條件式自適應訊號在多頭維持動能曝險、於空頭與轉折月部分脫鉤，顯著降低回撤。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 實作狀態條件自適應動能視窗切換：當全市場 63 日趨勢為正時採用中長動能（252 日），轉弱或高波動時自動切換為較短線／品質防禦權重：`if_else(ts_sum(group_mean(returns, 1, market), 63) > 0, group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 231)), industry), group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 63) / (ts_std_dev(returns, 63) + 1e-6)), industry))`。

net_new_papers.title: Momentum and the Cross-section of Stock Volatility
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 證明動能策略報酬的高不確定性源自個股橫斷面波動率——形成期實現波動率越高的個股越容易失去動能效應；提出廣義風險調整動能（GRJMOM），在股票、商品與債券等多資產類別全面提升報酬並降低崩盤風險。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 直接採用類似 GRJMOM 的個股形成期風險調整排序，在排序階段即懲罰高波動輸家／贏家，而非僅事後縮放槓桿：`group_neutralize(rank((ts_sum(returns, 231) - ts_sum(returns, 21)) / signed_power(ts_std_dev(returns, 231) + 1e-6, 1.5)), subindustry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Market volatility, momentum, and reversal: a switching strategy
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 當前期市場波動率處於相對高位時，動能利潤崩塌並轉為反轉；提出固定槓桿、無前視偏誤的「波動率切換策略」（高波動時從動能切換至反轉），在美股與國際市場徹底消除動能崩盤損失。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在 BRAIN 中以市場整體波動率分位數作為 Regime Switch 開關，低波動時執行 12-1 動能、極端高波動時反手執行 12-1 均值回歸（或短期反轉）：`if_else(ts_rank(ts_std_dev(group_mean(returns, 1, market), 21), 252) < 0.85, group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 231) - ts_sum(returns, 21)), industry), group_neutralize(-rank(ts_sum(returns, 21)), industry))`。

net_new_papers.title: Momentum Crashes and the 52-Week High
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 發現市場反彈期間投資人對「遠離 52 週高點」之股票湧入投機性買盤，是造成傳統動能崩盤的主因；若將動能策略對 52 週高點效應進行中性化修正，不僅顯著消弭崩盤與順週期性，跨子樣本與國際市場夏普比率皆提升。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構對「52 週高點距離」正交化（或中性化）的雙重排序殘差動能：將傳統 12-1 動能對 `close / ts_max(high, 252)` 進行橫斷面回歸取殘差（或分組中性化），切斷投機反彈風險：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 231) - ts_sum(returns, 21)) - rank(close / ts_max(high, 252)), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Frog in the Pan and the market-state effect on momentum
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 修正經典「溫水煮青蛙」（FIP）資訊離散度與動能的單調負相關關係：實證此負相關僅存在於多頭市場（UP state）；在空頭市場（DOWN state）中，資訊以更高離散度抵達投資人，導致 FIP 動能於空頭失效。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 將 FIP 連續資訊動能限定於市場處於多頭狀態時啟動，避免在空頭高離散度環境強行交易：`trade_when(ts_sum(group_mean(returns, 1, market), 252) > 0, group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 231) - ts_sum(returns, 21)) * rank(ts_mean(returns > 0, 231) - ts_mean(returns < 0, 231)), subindustry), -1)`。

net_new_papers.title: The 52-week High Momentum Strategy and Economic Policy Uncertainty (2022), Emerging Markets Finance and Trade, 58(2), 428–440
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 檢驗經濟政策不確定性（EPU）對 52 週高點動能的影響，證實因定錨偏誤驅動的 52 週高點動能在低政策不確定性時期極為強勁且無長期反轉，但在高不確定性時期幾乎消失。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在不確定性飆升（以全市場橫斷面報酬離散度或指數波動率代理 EPU）期間降低 52 週高點定錨因子權重，於平穩期滿倉配置：`group_neutralize(rank(close / ts_max(high, 252)), subindustry) * (1.2 - 0.5 * ts_rank(ts_std_dev(group_mean(returns, 1, market), 63), 252))`。

net_new_papers.title: Time-series residual momentum strategies (2022), Applied Economics, 54(5), 580–594
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 將殘差概念引入時間序列動能（TSMOM）並結合報酬自我共變異數性質進行權重配置，證實以因子殘差報酬而非原始報酬建構 TSMOM，在產業組合上能持續創造優於傳統等權 TSMOM 的超額績效。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在股票端先對產業報酬做殘差剝離，再對個股殘差報酬序列做正負號時間序列趨勢加權與波動率倒數縮放：`group_neutralize(sign(ts_sum(returns - group_mean(returns, 1, industry), 126)) * abs(ts_sum(returns - group_mean(returns, 1, industry), 126)) / (ts_std_dev(returns - group_mean(returns, 1, industry), 63) + 1e-6), market)`。

net_new_papers.title: The Optimal Market Mix for a Trend Follower
net_new_papers.track: Track 12: Quantitative Momentum & Trend Following: Residual Momentum, Crash-Protected Momentum, Time-Series Trend (CTA) & 52-Week High Anchoring
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 延伸趨勢速度研究（citing Mackic 2023），實證探討趨勢追蹤策略在不同資產類別與市場分散度下的夏普比率權衡，指出跨市場低相關性配置與適度趨勢速度管理是維持 CTA 長期正偏度與防禦危機的核心。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在跨產業／跨板塊股票池建構高度分散化的「因子中性趨勢因子」，對每個次產業內部強制去均值與波動率平價配置，避免單一熱門板塊主導組合風險：`group_neutralize(rank(ts_sum(returns, 126) / (ts_std_dev(returns, 63) + 1e-6)), subindustry)`，並配合低相關性多視窗平滑。

net_new_papers.title: Equity Issuance Methods and Dilution
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 建構理論與實證框架比較不同股權增資方式（公開現金增資、私募配售與附認股權發行）對現有股東的稀釋效應（Dilution）與逆向選擇成本，揭示發行折價與後續長期股價表現的結構性關聯。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「股權稀釋壓力（Net Share Dilution）」放空因子：追蹤過去 60–252 日流通股數異常擴張且帳面現金消耗快速之企業，在 BRAIN 中以 `group_neutralize(-rank(ts_delta(sharesout, 252) / (sharesout + 1)), subindustry)` 捕捉長期增資低報酬異象。

net_new_papers.title: Stock Returns and Earnings Persistence Following Equity Financing and Earnings Announcement: Considering Managerial Characteristics
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 實證探討企業在股權融資（Equity Financing）後的盈餘持續性與財報公告期股價報酬，證實管理層過度樂觀或治理弱化會加劇增資後的盈餘反轉與長期股價跑輸大盤現象。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 開發「增資後盈餘失望（Post-Issuance Earnings Reversal）」複合 Alpha：針對過去一年有股權淨發行、但應計項目（Accruals）偏高且分析師盈餘預測開始下修的標的建立空頭部位：`group_neutralize(-rank(ts_delta(sharesout, 252) / sharesout) * rank(ts_delta(est_eps_fy1, 20) * -1), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Why Do Firms Repurchase Their Shares When They Are Overpriced?
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 解釋為何企業常在股價高估時仍執行庫藏股回購：理論模型證明當自由現金流浪費風險高且公司治理健全時，回購高估股票仍可透過防止管理層過度投資（Overinvestment）而創造淨股東價值。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 修正「高估值回購必為負訊號」的線性假設：將庫藏股回購殖利率與企業自由現金流及低資本支出紀律結合，對高自由現金流但低資產擴張的高治理品質回購股給予定價溢價：`group_neutralize(rank(fnd6_prstkc / (cap + 1)) * rank(fnd6_oancf / (assets + 1)) * rank(-ts_delta(assets, 252) / assets), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Share Repurchases
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 系統性綜述全球股票回購（Share Repurchases）的市場擇時、流動性影響、稅務與監管摩擦及長期異常報酬，釐清公開市場回購宣告溢價與實際執行進度（Actual vs. Announced Buybacks）的定價差異。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在工程端嚴格區分「回購宣告（Announcement）」與「實際淨股數縮減（Actual Share Count Reduction）」：優先採用季報實際流通股數變動與現金流量表買回金額建構低換手長期多頭 Alpha，避免受限於僅宣告不執行的「空頭支票」雜訊。

net_new_papers.title: Debt Maturity Management
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 建構連續時間動態債務到期日管理模型，刻畫企業如何在降低發行交易成本、避免短期再融資擠兌風險（Rollover Risk）與抑制長期債務稀釋（Debt Dilution）之間進行最優債務期限結構動態調整。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「短期債務再融資懸崖（Maturity Wall / Short-Term Debt Ratio）」風險因子：計算一年內到期長期負債加計短期借款佔總負債比，在信用利差擴大期放空再融資壓力沉重且現金覆蓋不足的企業：`group_neutralize(-rank(fnd6_dlc / (fnd6_dltt + fnd6_dlc + 1)) * rank(-fnd6_che / (fnd6_dlc + 1)), subindustry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Corporate Debt Structure over the Global Credit Cycle
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 利用全球債券與貸款逐筆工具資料（Instrument-Level Data）分析企業主動提前償債與再融資決策：緊縮的全球信貸週期會顯著削弱企業透過提前再融資拉長債務期限、降低利息支出與緩解展期風險的能力。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建立全球信貸週期狀態調節的「債務久期與展期彈性」因子：當全球高收益債信用利差（HY OAS）處於擴張緊縮區間時，調高企業長期債占比與利息覆蓋率的權重，並懲罰高度依賴浮動利率銀行短期貸款之標的。

net_new_papers.title: Time Inconsistency and Financial Covenants
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 剖析企業在無承諾能力下的動態發債時間不一致性（Time Inconsistency）問題，證明債務契約中的財務限制條款（Financial Covenants）如何抑制事後過度舉債與資產替代，進而提升企業債務容量與權益估值穩定度。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 於基本面信用因子中納入「契約條款違約緩衝空間（Covenant Slack）」代理指標：以 `(EBITDA / Total Debt)` 及 `(Interest Coverage)` 與同業違約門檻的距離衡量企業面臨債權人強制緊縮融資的風險，篩選具高度融資自主權之多頭標的。

net_new_papers.title: Debt Maturity and Commitment on Firm Policies
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 在無法對未來發債承諾的動態模型中解析短期債務作為自我約束機制的功能：適當配置短期債務雖帶來再融資風險，但能抑制管理層過度舉債與無效率投資，進而決定企業最優資本結構與股票橫截面風險溢價。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「債務期限紀律與投資效率」交互因子：區分「高投資成長期的短債紀律」與「低成長衰退期的短債擠兌風險」，於景氣擴張期做多短債比例適中且資本配置 ROIC 領先同業之企業。

net_new_papers.title: Corporate Debt Maturity and Investment Over the Business Cycle
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 實證與量化模型證實企業債務期限選擇與資本投資呈現高度順週期聯動：衰退期信貸凍結迫使企業縮短新債期限並大幅削減實質投資，使高短期債務暴露企業在衰退期的現金流與股價波動顯著加劇。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 設計景氣週期條件式「投資－債務期限協同（Debt-Investment Cyclicality）」因子：在衰退預警期提前減碼「高短期債務到期比例＋高資本支出依賴度」的資本密集型企業，轉向低資本支出、長債鎖利之現金牛標的。

net_new_papers.title: Rollover Risk and Tax Avoidance
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 證實面臨高度債務展期風險（Rollover Risk，以即將到期長期債務佔比衡量）的企業，會更積極透過激進避稅（Tax Avoidance）來保留內部現金流以替代昂貴的外部再融資，但同時也放大了會計不透明度與股價崩盤風險。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「展期壓力誘發之稅務激進與盈餘品質惡化」放空過濾器：當高到期債務比企業伴隨有效稅率（ETR）異常驟降與應計項目上升時，識別其為現金流緊繃的偽獲利標的並加以放空：`group_neutralize(-rank(fnd6_dlc / (assets + 1)) * rank(-ts_delta(fnd6_txt / (fnd6_pi + 1), 252)), sector)`。

net_new_papers.title: Corporate Debt and Stock Returns: Evidence from U.S. Firms During the 2020 Oil Crash
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 以 2020 年油價崩盤為外生大宗商品衝擊，實證檢驗企業既有債務結構如何傳導衝擊至股價報酬：在產業負面衝擊期間，高槓桿且短期到期債務比例較高的企業承受顯著更深且無法迅速修復的股價跌幅。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建立「大宗商品／產業外生衝擊下的資產負債表脆弱度」防禦因子：當能源、原物料或特定產業 ETF 波動率急升時，於該產業內部做多低淨槓桿（Net Debt / EBITDA）、做空高短期到期負債之脆弱同業。

net_new_papers.title: Investment, Implicit Debt Targets and Debt Maturity
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 提出企業存在「隱含目標負債率（Implicit Debt Target）」的實證模型，證實企業進行實質資本投資與債務期限調整並非孤立決策，偏離隱含目標負債率的投資擴張會顯著改變後續資本成本與股票預期報酬。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「隱含目標槓桿偏離度 × 資產成長」雙重因子：計算企業當前槓桿相對於其過去 3–5 年滾動均值或產業中位數的偏離值，對超額舉債擴張資產（High Leverage Deviation + High Asset Growth）的企業進行放空。

net_new_papers.title: Understanding the Asset Growth Anomaly
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 拆解資產負債表「資產成長異象（Asset Growth Anomaly）」的驅動來源，發現過去強烈的負向報酬主要由與「盈餘管理／應計項目」相關的流動資產膨脹所貢獻；在《沙賓法案》（SOX）提升會計誠信後，純應計驅動的資產成長異象大幅衰減。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 精煉傳統 `asset_growth` Alpha：將總資產成長率拆解為「非現金營運資金／應計膨脹項」與「實質固定資本支出／併購擴張項」，剔除雜訊並鎖定純應計過度擴張且伴隨負自由現金流之標的做空：`group_neutralize(-rank(ts_delta(assets - fnd6_che, 252) / (assets + 1)), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Real Options and CEO Social Connections: The Role of Financial Flexibility
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 探討財務彈性（Financial Flexibility）與管理層外部網路如何共同影響企業執行實質選擇權的效率：高財務彈性顯著放大企業在高度不確定環境下把握成長選擇權的能力，並轉化為更優異的投資效率與股東價值。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「財務彈性 × 成長機會（Financial Flexibility × Investment Efficiency）」多頭策略：篩選同時具備低槓桿、充沛現金緩衝與高投資邊際報酬（ROIC > WACC）的企業，捕捉不確定性環境下的實質選擇權執行溢價。

net_new_papers.title: Cash-Hedged Stock Returns
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 提出「現金對沖股票報酬（Cash-Hedged Stock Returns）」定價框架，將個股報酬與 Beta 分解為企業帳上現金部位報酬與純營運資產報酬；證實傳統因子組合隱含大量相關性極高的現金頭寸，剔除現金部位後的現金對沖因子組合擁有顯著更高的夏普比率。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在 BRAIN 工程端實作「企業現金部位中性化（Enterprise-Value / Cash-Hedged Return Adjustment）」：計算因子報酬時扣除公司現金佔市值比重 `(Cash / Market Cap)` 所貢獻的無風險報酬稀釋效應，將選股 Alpha 精準聚焦於純營運企業價值（EV）報酬。

net_new_papers.title: Cash, Risk, and Return: Decoding Precautionary Motives
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 透過預防性儲蓄（Precautionary Savings）視角提出前瞻性指標「現金市值比（Cash-to-ME）」，證實相較於傳統現金資產比（Cash-to-Assets），`Cash-to-ME` 能穩定正向預測股票橫截面報酬，且在面臨融資摩擦的高研發小型股中溢價最顯著。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 直接在 BRAIN 建構 `Cash-to-ME` 預防性現金風險溢價 Alpha，取代傳統失效的 `Cash-to-Assets`，並與研發密度或現金流 Beta 交互強化：`group_neutralize(rank(fnd6_che / (cap + 1)) * rank(1 + fnd6_xrd / (cap + 1)), subindustry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Cash Holdings and Risk-Adjusted Returns: The Role of Business Strategy, Life Cycle, and Managerial Ability
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 以產業中位數調整現金比（MACR）衡量超額現金持有，發現高現金持有並非一概低報酬：處於「成長期（Growth-Phase）」、採行「探索者策略（Prospector）」或具高管理能力的企業，持有超額現金反而能創造顯著正向風險調整超額報酬。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「產業調整超額現金 × 營收成長與管理效能」條件式多頭策略：避免機械式懲罰高現金企業，僅對「成熟低成長且管理效率低落」的現金囤積者做空，而對高營收成長與高資產週轉率的高現金企業做多。

net_new_papers.title: How Valuable Is Financial Flexibility When Revenue Stops? Evidence from the COVID-19 Crisis
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 透過外生營收停擺衝擊實證量化「財務彈性（高現金、低短期債務、低長期債務）」的危機對沖價值：高財務彈性企業在衝擊期股價跌幅比低彈性企業少 26%（9.7 個百分點），且過去三年零股利／回購的現金保留政策在危機期具備顯著估值保護。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 開發「總經危機期財務彈性防禦對沖組合（Crisis Financial Flexibility Factor）」：當市場波動率（VIX）或信用利差突破歷史高分位時，一鍵切換至高現金覆蓋率與低短期債務比率之防禦性多空組合：`group_neutralize(rank(fnd6_che / (assets + 1)) - rank((fnd6_dlc + fnd6_dltt) / (assets + 1)), sector)`。

net_new_papers.title: Rules Versus Discretion in Capital Regulation
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 在動態資本結構與監管架構下比較「規則基礎（Rules-Based）」與「裁量權基礎（Discretionary）」資本約束對金融中介與企業融資供給的影響，揭示資本緩衝監管摩擦如何改變市場風險承擔與股權融資成本。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 針對金融與高監管槓桿板塊建構「超額資本緩衝（Capital Buffer Cushion）」因子：衡量金融機構實際資本適足率／權益資產比高於監管下限的空間，在信用緊縮週期做多高資本緩衝機構、放空瀕臨監管觸發線的脆弱標的。

net_new_papers.title: Asset Pricing in Bull and Bear Markets
net_new_papers.track: Track 13: Corporate Payouts, Capital Allocation & Financing Anomalies: Net Share Issuance, Debt Issuance, Investment-to-Assets & Cash Holdings Valuation
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 依多頭與空頭市場狀態條件檢驗 Hou-Xue-Zhang (2020) 187 項資本配置、投資、獲利與無形資產異象的表現，證實多數總期顯著異象在空頭市場表現大幅衰減，僅有 27 項在多空雙狀態皆穩健；且 Q5 因子模型在多頭期對投資與獲利異象解釋力最佳，FF6 則在空頭期較佳。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在 BRAIN 多因子權重配置中導入「多空市場狀態條件切換（Bull/Bear Anomaly Regime Switching）」：多頭期側重 Q5 架構下的投資與 ROE 動能因子，空頭期則收斂至多空雙穩健之低資產成長、高淨現金流與低摩擦核心因子，顯著提升策略全天候夏普比率。

net_new_papers.title: Recovering the FOMC risk premium
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 提出從市場數據還原每場 FOMC 會議事前風險溢酬與多空漂移幅度的結構化方法（1996–2019 年 192 場會議平均溢酬 45 bps、範圍 1–326 bps），樣本外預測會議窗口報酬之 $R^2$ 達 7.51%。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 將事前估計的 FOMC 條件風險溢酬轉化為橫截面槓桿調節係數：當預估會議溢酬高於歷史 75 分位時，放大高動能／高市場 Beta 組合權重：`rank(beta_mkt) * rank(fomc_recovered_prem)`。

net_new_papers.title: The Economics of the Fed Put
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 透過對 FOMC 會議記錄與文件進行文本分析，證實 1990 年代中期以來美股負報酬與聯準會下修成長預期及後續寬鬆政策高度共變，主要透過財富消費效應傳導，而非單純道德風險過度反應。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構「Fed Put 觸發機率」條件輪動因子：當過去 20 日大盤顯著回撤且聯準會言論出現金融狀況／財富效應關鍵字時，做多對降息預期最敏感的高久期成長股：`rank(equity_duration) * (-mkt_ret_20d > 0.05)`。

net_new_papers.title: Fearing the Fed: How wall street reads main street
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 實證顯示美股對重大總經公告（MNA）意外的敏感度具明顯逆週期性：擴張初期敏感度最高，擴張末期幾乎歸零；利用股債公告日共變方向拆解，證實當市場擔憂「好消息引發升息」時，現金流利多會被無風險利率預期抵銷。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 利用股債公告日滾動相關性進行制度切換（Regime Switching）：當 `ts_corr(spx_ret, tlt_ret, 60)` 由負轉正（通膨／升息主導期），於 CPI／NFP 日反轉對高估成長股之曝險：`sign(-ts_corr(spx_ret, tlt_ret, 60)) * rank(mna_surprise_beta)`。

net_new_papers.title: Intervening against the Fed
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 結合外匯干預政策偏離與高頻美國貨幣政策衝擊，發現未干預下美國緊縮衝擊透過匯率貶值與資產負債表通道重創具「美元債務」之外國企業股價，而央行逆勢外匯干預可完全抵銷此股價跌幅。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 針對非美市場或具高外幣負債曝險跨國企業建構衝擊對沖 Alpha：在緊縮性 FOMC 衝擊後做空未受外匯干預保護的高美元負債比公司：`rank(-usd_debt_ratio) * rank(-fx_reserve_buffer) * hawkish_fomc_flag`。

net_new_papers.title: FOMC news and segmented markets
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 以選擇權隱含的短期股息剝離報酬（SDR）衡量市場對 FOMC 資訊之即時更新：SDR 顯著預測未來公司盈餘與財報公告日超額報酬，但賣方分析師盈餘預測存在明顯反應不足（underreaction）。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 利用「選擇權市場領先分析師修正」之跨市場資訊落差建構 Alpha：計算 FOMC 後短期股息／選擇權隱含成長訊號與分析師盈餘修正之分歧度，做多選擇權端看多但分析師尚未上調之高營運槓桿股。

net_new_papers.title: Factor returns and FOMC announcements: The role of sentiment
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 檢驗 Fama-French 因子在 FOMC 公告日的報酬表現與投資人情緒的交互作用：規模（SMB）與動能／投資等因子在公告日的風險溢酬高度取決於事前市場情緒（Baker-Wurgler 情緒或 VIX 狀態）。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 建構 FOMC 窗口專屬因子擇時權重：在高投資人情緒期於公告日側重防禦型低波動／獲利因子（RMW），於低迷悲觀情緒期切換至高 Beta 小型價值股（SMB + HML），提升多因子組合公告日 Sharpe。

net_new_papers.title: Real-time price discovery via verbal communication: Method and application to Fedspeak
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 將 FOMC 會後記者會影片逐字切分並以毫秒時間戳對齊高頻資產價格，發現政策聲明發布時的價格變動顯著預測隨後記者會的價格方向（S&P 500 相關性達 44%），特別集中於主席解釋聲明文字變動之分鐘，證實投資人存在資訊僵固性。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 利用聲明發布（14:00）至記者會開始前（14:30）之方向動能進行事件日內／隔夜延續交易，並計算聲明文本逐字差異度（Jaccard / Cosine Distance）：`sign(ret_statement) * text_diff_score` 預測記者會與次日延續漂移。

net_new_papers.title: Using Generative AI Models to Understand FOMC Monetary Policy Discussions
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 聯準會官方測試多款大型語言模型（LLM）對 2010 年以來 FOMC 會議紀要（Minutes）逐句進行七大主題（通膨、勞動、金融穩定、資產負債表等）分類，證實 LLM 在識別政策焦點轉移（如 2021 年通膨急升與 2018 年縮表）具極高 F1 準確率。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 使用 LLM 抽取每期 FOMC 會議紀要中「通膨、金融穩定、勞動市場」句子占比變動 `delta_topic_share`，作為領先債市／股市體制轉換的結構化特徵輸入橫截面行業輪動模型。

net_new_papers.title: FedSight AI: Multi-Agent System Architecture for Federal Funds Target Rate Prediction
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 提出多代理人 LLM 架構模擬 FOMC 委員審議與投票過程，結合結構化總經指標與褐皮書（Beige Book）非結構化文本及 Chain-of-Draft 推理，於 2023–2024 年 16 次會議達成 93.75% 利率決策預測準確率。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 將多代理人模型對下次 FOMC 升息／降息機率分布與 CME FedWatch 隱含機率之差值作為「政策預期差訊號（Model-vs-Market Wedge）」，於會議前夕對利率敏感股建構方向性 Alpha。

net_new_papers.title: Decoding central bank communications with large language models
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 運用大型語言模型大規模解碼各國央行溝通文本的鷹鴿立場與不確定性維度，證實 LLM 抽取的語意立場指標能顯著解釋主權殖利率曲線與股市跨資產反應，表現優於傳統詞典法（Dictionary-based）。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 計算主要央行（Fed、ECB、BoJ）會議聲明與講話之 LLM 鷹鴿分歧度與語氣動能 `ts_delta(llm_hawkish_score, 1)`，跨國配置對匯率與利率敏感之出口型／內需型類股。

net_new_papers.title: Uncertainty and cross-sectional stock returns: Evidence from China
net_new_papers.track: Track 14: Macroeconomic Announcements & Central Bank Communication Alpha: FOMC / CPI / NFP Drift, Pre-Announcement Premia & Policy Uncertainty
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 區分「總經不確定性」與「金融不確定性」對橫截面股價報酬之定價：僅總經不確定性 Beta 顯著定價（低 Beta 股票享有顯著較高超額報酬），因總經不確定性為領先惡化之狀態變數，金融不確定性則無顯著定價溢酬。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 在建構不確定性避險因子時剝離純市場波動率（VIX），僅對實體總經／政策不確定性（EPU／Macro Uncertainty）計算條件 Beta：`rank(-ts_reg_beta(ret, d_epu, 252))` 並對 VIX Beta 進行正交化處理。

net_new_papers.title: Option-implied idiosyncratic skewness and expected returns: Mind the long run
net_new_papers.track: Track 15: Options-Implied Information & Equity Return Predictability: Put-Call Ratios, Risk-Neutral Skewness/Kurtosis, Pin Risk & GEX
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 建構月頻期權隱含特質偏度（idiosyncratic skewness），實證其對美國股市風險溢酬具備長達 36 個月的樣本內與樣本外顯著預測力；該指標呈順週期性，在景氣衰退前顯著下降，反映前瞻性投資人情緒與意見分歧。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 提取長週期特質偏度動能訊號：`group_neutralize(ts_mean(rank(implied_volatility_call_90 - implied_volatility_put_90), 21), sector)`。

net_new_papers.title: Firm-Specific Risk-Neutral Distributions with Options and CDS
net_new_papers.track: Track 15: Options-Implied Information & Equity Return Predictability: Put-Call Ratios, Risk-Neutral Skewness/Kurtosis, Pin Risk & GEX
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 整合個股期權與信用違約交換（CDS）報價估計公司層級風險中性機率分佈（RND），相較單純使用期權能更精準捕捉極端左尾違約機率與尾部風險定價，強化尾部風險因子對未來股票報酬的解釋力。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 融合債權違約風險與期權隱含左尾陡度：`group_neutralize(-rank(implied_volatility_put_60 * (debt_lt / assets)), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Option-implied moments and the cross-section of stock returns
net_new_papers.track: Track 15: Options-Implied Information & Equity Return Predictability: Put-Call Ratios, Risk-Neutral Skewness/Kurtosis, Pin Risk & GEX
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 結合期權隱含波動率、偏度與峰度建構綜合評分指標，最高與最低十分位數多空組合獲顯著月均 0.75% 價值加權報酬；低情緒期由總體波動率風險驅動，高情緒期則由期權至現股的資訊流主導。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 多動差合成排序 Alpha：`group_neutralize(rank(implied_volatility_call_30 - implied_volatility_put_30) - rank(implied_volatility_30 - historical_volatility_30), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Options Trading and Stock Price Informativeness
net_new_papers.track: Track 15: Options-Implied Information & Equity Return Predictability: Put-Call Ratios, Risk-Neutral Skewness/Kurtosis, Pin Risk & GEX
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 檢驗期權交易量與選擇權上市對現股價格資訊含量（price informativeness）之影響，發現活躍的期權市場能吸引知情交易者利用槓桿交易基本面資訊，進而提升長期盈餘預測準確度與市場定價效率。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 以期權現股成交比（O/S）加權基本面動能加速價格發現：`group_neutralize(rank(option_volume / volume) * rank(ts_delta(eps, 63)), sector)`。

net_new_papers.title: The Information in Hedge Fund Option Holdings
net_new_papers.track: Track 15: Options-Implied Information & Equity Return Predictability: Put-Call Ratios, Risk-Neutral Skewness/Kurtosis, Pin Risk & GEX
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 避險基金期權部位蘊含顯著看空資訊且獨立於融券餘額（short interest）；高融券餘額搭配避險基金看空期權部位之負向異常報酬為看多部位的四倍以上，且在市場壓力期與資金受限基金中資訊含量更強。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 融券放空比率與看跌期權隱含波動率溢價共振作空因子：`group_neutralize(-rank(short_interest / sharesout) * rank(implied_volatility_put_30 - implied_volatility_call_30), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: Option trading volume by moneyness, firm fundamentals, and stock returns
net_new_papers.track: Track 15: Options-Implied Information & Equity Return Predictability: Put-Call Ratios, Risk-Neutral Skewness/Kurtosis, Pin Risk & GEX
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 跨到期日之高期權總成交量、深價內（DITM）賣權與深價外（DOTM）買權成交量，顯著預測公司未來槓桿上升、違約風險增加、負向盈餘驚奇與獲利下滑，並負向預測未來股票報酬，於低機構持股標的尤為顯著。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 反向篩選過度投機期權成交量與低機構覆蓋標的：`group_neutralize(-rank(option_volume / (volume + 1)) * (1 - rank(institutional_ownership)), industry)`。

net_new_papers.title: FOMO: FLEX Options and Market Outcomes
net_new_papers.track: Track 15: Options-Implied Information & Equity Return Predictability: Put-Call Ratios, Risk-Neutral Skewness/Kurtosis, Pin Risk & GEX
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: 研究 2014–2024 年機構客製化 FLEX 期權日均量從 6 萬口暴增至 80 萬口的市場外溢效應，實證機構透過 FLEX 進行對沖、結構型商品與借券轉換（conversion/reversal），並顯著影響標準上市期權與現股之流動性與定價。
net_new_papers.fastexpr_idea: 追蹤非標準化異常期權量能或價差擴大對現股流動性衝擊之回歸：`group_neutralize(-rank(ts_std_dev(option_volume, 20) / ts_mean(option_volume, 60)), sector)`。

net_new_papers.title: Cross-Impact of Order Flow Imbalance in Equity Markets
net_new_papers.authors: Rama Cont, Mihai Cucuringu & Chao Zhang
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Multi-level Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) and cross-asset OFI regressions substantially improve contemporaneous and short-horizon return prediction over single-asset best-quote OFI via a sparse low-rank cross-impact matrix.

net_new_papers.title: Attention-Based Reading, Highlighting, and Forecasting of the Limit Order Book
net_new_papers.authors: Jiwon Jung & Kiseop Lee
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Develops a compound multivariate spatiotemporal embedding and attention Seq2Seq architecture to forecast the entire multi-level LOB (prices and volumes across levels) while preserving ordinal book structure.

net_new_papers.title: The Price Impact of Generalized Order Flow Imbalance
net_new_papers.authors: Yuhan Su, Zeyu Sun, Jiarong Li & Xianghui Yuan
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Accounts for non-minimum tick price changes to construct Generalized Stationarized Order Flow Imbalance (`log-GOFI`), boosting out-of-sample $R^2$ on CSI 500 30s–5m returns from ~33–43% (standard OFI) to ~84–86%.

net_new_papers.title: Forecasting High Frequency Order Flow Imbalance Using Hawkes Processes
net_new_papers.authors: Aditya Nittur Anantha & Shashi Jain
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Models asymmetric, mutually-exciting bid/ask arrivals with Sum-of-Exponentials Hawkes processes to forecast the near-term conditional distribution of OFI rather than point estimates alone.

net_new_papers.title: Order Scoring, Bandit Learning and Order Cancellations
net_new_papers.authors: Xuefeng Gao & Tianrun Xu
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Formulates a dynamic stochastic order-scoring model incorporating bid-ask queue imbalance and queue position, paired with Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) multi-armed bandit learning to optimize limit-order cancellation decisions.

net_new_papers.title: Leveraging IS and TC: Optimal Order Execution Subject to Reference Strategies
net_new_papers.authors: Xue Cheng, Peng Guo & Tai-Ho Wang
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Solves closed-form utility-maximizing execution subject to client-mandated reference benchmarks (e.g., VWAP/TWAP), proving optimal trajectories form affine combinations of Implementation Shortfall (IS) and Target Close (TC) basis orders.

net_new_papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Execution when Liquidity is Time-Varying
net_new_papers.authors: Andrea Macrì & Fabrizio Lillo
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Uses Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQN) in an Almgren-Chriss setting with latent, stochastic temporary and permanent impact parameters, learning near-optimal dynamic schedules without observing real-time liquidity states.

net_new_papers.title: Optimal Portfolio Choice with Cross-Impact Propagators
net_new_papers.authors: Eduardo Abi Jaber, Eyal Neuman & Sturmius Tuschmann
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Solves multi-asset continuous-time portfolio optimization with alpha signals under matrix-valued Volterra transient cross-impact propagators via operator resolvents, establishing no-price-manipulation conditions.

net_new_papers.title: A Bayesian Theory of Market Impact
net_new_papers.authors: Louis Saddier & Matteo Marsili
net_new_papers.track: Track 16: Order Book Imbalance, Queue Position, Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss / VWAP / TWAP) & Market Impact Models
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Derives the square-root impact law, its small-volume linear crossover, and post-execution price reversion from minimal Bayesian price-setting where market makers infer metaorder direction and trading speed from order flow.

net_new_papers.title: Firm Investment and the User Cost of Capital: New U.S. Corporate Tax Reform Evidence
net_new_papers.authors: Jonathan S. Hartley, Kevin A. Hassett & Joshua D. Rauh
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Exploits TCJA cross-asset variation in user cost of capital and METR; a 1 percentage point drop in user cost drives a 1.68–3.05 percentage point rise in investment rates, validating tax-adjusted Q-theory pricing.

net_new_papers.title: When Tax Shields Shrink: Interest Deductibility Limitations and Corporate Innovation
net_new_papers.authors: Xinru Chen, Mara Faccio, Stefano Manfredonia & Jin Xu
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Exploits TCJA Section 163(j) interest deductibility caps and EU earnings-stripping rules; shrinking debt tax shields forces firms to deleverage and cut exploitative patenting, linking debt tax shields directly to R&D asset growth.

net_new_papers.title: The tax shield increases the interest rate
net_new_papers.authors: Marcel Fischer & Bjarne Astrup Jensen
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: General equilibrium asset pricing model proving corporate debt tax shields endogenously raise equilibrium risk-free and borrowing interest rates, altering optimal leverage and WACC discounting for tax shields.

net_new_papers.title: Tax outcome smoothness and the cost of equity capital
net_new_papers.authors: Natalie Kyung Won Kim & Taejin Jung
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Across U.S. firms (1994–2024), smoother realized cash effective tax rates (distinct from tax avoidance level) predict lower implied cost of equity capital, higher tax persistence, and lower IRS audit/tax-shelter risk.

net_new_papers.title: The role of shifts in the effective tax rate on the cost of equity
net_new_papers.authors: Javier Rojo-Suárez & Ana B. Alonso-Conde
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Conditional asset pricing model incorporating time-varying effective corporate tax rates; shifts in corporate tax rates significantly explain cross-sectional anomaly returns, while tax-burden uncertainty commands a higher equity risk premium.

net_new_papers.title: The demand for tax-favored risky assets with capital gains tax exclusions, tax policy uncertainty, and its implications for pricing
net_new_papers.authors: Yehuda Davis, Suresh Govindaraj & Tavish Tejas
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Equilibrium portfolio choice model with capital gains tax exclusions and tax rate uncertainty; identifies endogenous regimes where tax exclusions increase, leave unchanged, or paradoxically reduce risky asset demand and equilibrium prices.

net_new_papers.title: Corporate taxes, partisan politics, and stock returns
net_new_papers.authors: *Economics & Finance*
net_new_papers.venue: *North American Journal of Economics and Finance*, 72
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Shows corporate tax measures predict cross-sectional U.S. stock returns via a cash-flow channel when interacted with partisan political cycles, yielding abnormal trading profits due to partial investor anticipation.

net_new_papers.title: State corporate tax changes and bond pricing: U.S. evidence
net_new_papers.authors: Hong Zhao, Hao Shen, Haizhi Wang & Yun Zhu
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Exploits staggered U.S. state corporate tax changes; state tax hikes widen at-issue corporate bond yield spreads by 34 bps (asymmetric vs. tax cuts) via higher leverage and return volatility, triggering negative equity reactions.

net_new_papers.title: Corporate tax avoidance and stock returns
net_new_papers.authors: *International Review of Financial Analysis*
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Examines tax-plan enforcement pressure and equity valuation; reduced tax avoidance lowers stock returns under heavy tax-plan pressure via political cost signaling, though non-SOEs partially offset cash outflows via cheaper debt access.

net_new_papers.title: Corporate taxes and corporate social responsibility
net_new_papers.authors: Xin Chang, Yaling Jin, Endong Yang & Wenrui Zhang
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Uses staggered state corporate tax cuts and the 2017 TCJA; tax cuts expand internal cash flows and boost ESG/CSR scores (especially for financially constrained and high-tax-exposure firms), while tax hikes show downward stickiness.

net_new_papers.title: Estimating the Present Value of R&D Tax Benefits in the United States
net_new_papers.authors: Brandon Pecoraro et al. (JCT Staff)
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Uses confidential IRS corporate tax panels to compute exact present-value R&D tax shields; PV drops to $0.27 ($0.23 for young/small firms) for loss-making firms due to NOL carryforward delays, creating sharp cross-sectional subsidy wedges.

net_new_papers.title: R&D tax credits and innovation
net_new_papers.authors: Walter Melnik & Andrew Smyth
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Exploits staggered U.S. state-level R&D tax credit adoptions; credits lower user cost of R&D and substantially raise patent novelty and stock-market-implied patent values, concentrated among large firms in high-credit states.

net_new_papers.title: R&D Tax Incentive Reforms Around the World: The Impact on Firm Value
net_new_papers.authors: Kun Tracy Wang, Sonali Walpola, Nathan Zhenghang Zhu & Intan Ulima
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Cross-country DiD across global R&D tax reforms; R&D super-deductions significantly boost firm valuation (Tobin's Q) via innovation efficiency, outperforming patent boxes while exhibiting strong complementarity with patent box regimes.

net_new_papers.title: Does a consistently capitalized R&D ratio improve information effects of capitalized development expenditures?
net_new_papers.authors: Joe (Joonghi) Cho & Heejung Kim
net_new_papers.track: Track 17: Corporate Tax Policy, R&D Tax Credits, Depreciation Shields & Effective Tax Rate Quantitative Asset Pricing
net_new_papers.key_mechanism: Measures 5-year coefficient of variation of R&D capitalization ratios; capitalized development costs are value-relevant and improve stock return informativeness for future earnings only when capitalization policy is time-consistent.

net_new_papers.title: Tax uncertainty, cash holdings and corporate investment
